description: Fear-driven narratives produce coercive and exclusionary demographic policy.
Deterrence and exclusion increase irregularity exploitation and political polarization.
Climate stress drives displacement housing pressure and protection gaps.
Aging societies rely on migrant care workers without fair labor or family protections.
Aging pressure intensifies while care health housing and pension systems lag.
Large youth cohorts experience weak opportunity and limited institutional inclusion.
Legal mobility pathways and protection systems reduce demographic stress.
Inclusive urban investment improves housing care labor integration and social cohesion.
